title: Add Service at another location copies the same work at this location's rates
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in with Create and edit work orders at a location that is NOT the schedule's home location (a multi-workplace org), build under test, maintenance_reminders flag on.
  2. A work order at this location carries an asset enrolled on a schedule built at another location (e.g. home 'Calgary South', here 'Lethbridge'), with a due service 'PM-A' that has canned lines.
  3. Open the work order's maintenance panel and expand it.
custom_steps:
1. Read the row at this (non-home) location and its (i) note.
  2. Use Add Service and read the modal's preview (no parts listed).
  3. Check each added line's labour type and rate.
  4. Confirm prices and parts are not copied, and tracking/completion stay organization-wide.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • At a location other than the home location, the row reads exactly as at home (e.g. 'PM-A, Overdue · Aug 2026, 4 lines · 2.8 hours, Add Service') with an (i) explaining the lines were set up at the home location and the same work is added here at this location's rates.
  • Add Service adds the same work (each canned line's name, description and hours) as new lines at this location's rates; prices and parts are not copied, because both are kept per location.
  • Each copied line takes this location's labour type of the same name, or the default labour type where none matches, priced at that rate; a fixed-price line is priced the same way here.
  • The Add Service modal's preview lists no parts here; tracking and completion stay organization-wide.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-3780 (Maintenance Reminders); story SV-10572 (S16, The maintenance panel on a work order); Chunk 2 MR spec (Confluence 897679389), Part 1 / S16; read 2 Oct 2026. Source-verified 2 October 2026; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S16-R21: “At a location other than the home location, the row reads exactly as it does at home, for example PM-A, Overdue · Aug 2026, 4 lines · 2.8 hours, Add Service, with an (i) beside it: PM-A's lines were set up at Calgary South. We add the same work here at Lethbridge's rates. Parts are not added; each line's note lists the parts Calgary South uses, for reference”
  • S16-N6: “Add Service at a location other than the schedule's home location adds the same work, not the home location's lines: each canned line's name, description and hours, as new lines at this location's rates. Prices and parts are not copied, because both are kept per location. Tracking and completion stay organization-wide, per S18-R12”
  • S16-R22: “Each copied line takes this location's labour type of the same name, or this location's default labour type where none matches, and is priced at that labour type's rate. A line that is fixed price at the home location is priced the same way here”
  • S16-R24: “The Add Service modal is the standard one at every location. At a location other than the home location its preview lists no parts, because none are added; the card's (i) of S16-R21 is the only place that explains the copy”
